# C flags for the vendored musl libm subset (vendor/musl-math), shared by both builds so that
# sin/cos/atan/atan2/pow are bit-identical on WebAssembly and x86-64 (glibc's differ in the
# last bit). -fvisibility=hidden keeps the symbols private to the Python extension.
-std=gnu11
-O3
-ffp-contract=off
-fno-builtin
-fvisibility=hidden
-w
